title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - DemandDrivenProfile
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/DemandDrivenProfile. The Flexibility Profile following the Demand Driven strategy. Subclass of FlexibilityProfile per the SAREF4ENER ontology; inherited properties are documented on the FlexibilityProfile model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'DemandDrivenProfile'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasDemandRate.description: Relationship. The present demand rate that needs to be satisfied by the system Relationship to NumberRange.

hasDemandRateForecast.description: Relationship. This property relates a Demand Driven Profile to a TimeSeries object that indicates a forecast of the average demand rate. Relationship to TimeSeries.

isActuatedBy.description: Relationship. A reference to an (external) actuator that can potentially activate this profile or where the instruction originates from. References an external/core-SAREF concept (Actuator) not itself translated in this candidate.
